note: Paths are relative to this folder. The manifest has two lists, "declarations" and "fields" (there is no "tools" list: the tool list rules are those of mcp-tool-set-digest/1, whose own vectors are in ../third_party/mcp-tool-set-digest-1/). A declaration case gives the declaration, the public key record, the clock time, and optionally "tools" (one tools/list page), "previous" (the earlier declaration) and "formats" (the formats the check accepts; all formats when absent). "expect" holds the state, exit code and declaration hash, and optionally: "format", the format checked; "toolSetDigest", a compact form of the result of SPEC.md section 17.3 ("contract" and "extras" are the result words match, mismatch or no_digest; "contractCode" and "extrasCode" the TSD code of a no_digest result, null when the list cannot be read at all; "differs", "noDigest", "repeatedMembers" and "repeatedNames" as in the verifier output); "chain", members of the chain object of SPEC.md section 7; "keyChangeNote" and "formatChangeNote", true when the output has to say that the key, or the format, changed along the link (the reference verifier writes "key changed" and "format changed" in its notes). Field vectors change ed25519-valid.json: "value" sets the member at "pointer", "remove": true removes it; "accept" means the file still passes step 1 of SPEC.md section 11 under the 0.2 rules, "reject" means malformed.
